1101e1e43a54.zh: 2.10 · 早期神經網路模型 · EARLY NEURAL MODELS

17ccbc84a2d5.zh:
RBF 與 SOM 的
奇幻漂流

aac4f5c283fa.zh: 一個看準地方插旗，一個自己找同類湊成地圖。
aac4f5c283fa.en: One aims carefully before planting its flags; the other finds its own kind and pieces them together into a map.

14bf60da4a0e.zh: RBF：監督式區域性感應 → 加權輸出　·　SOM：無監督拓撲保序 → 自組織地圖
14bf60da4a0e.en: RBF: supervised local sensing → weighted output · SOM: unsupervised topology preservation → self-organizing map

1b57ff06b479.zh: 名師導讀講義逐字稿 · Guided lecture notes

169d48a2a6ce.zh:
沒有標準答案時，神經網路還能自己找到地圖嗎？
    <small>Can a neural model discover structure without labels?</small>
169d48a2a6ce.en: When there is no answer key, can a neural network still find a map on its own?

a0a82968d01d.zh: 兩種「偷懶」思路 Two clever shortcuts

dfd890b2b64c.zh: RBF 與 SOM 都不是現在深度學習的主線，卻把「區域性感應」與「自組織拓撲」這兩種重要想法講得很清楚。Both models sit beside today’s deep-learning mainstream, but expose two durable ideas: locality and topology.
dfd890b2b64c.en: Neither RBF nor SOM is part of today’s deep-learning mainstream, yet they spell out two important ideas very clearly: “local sensing” and “self-organizing topology.”

a70696bb0776.zh: RBF：看準地方再插旗 Place local flags
a70696bb0776.en: RBF: take aim, then plant the flag

e62c747748f1.zh: 它是監督式學習：有輸入，也有標準答案。第一層先在資料空間放置中心與感應範圍，第二層再學如何加權組合這些區域性訊號。Supervised learning: fixed local responses first, trainable output weights second.
e62c747748f1.en: It is supervised learning: there are inputs, and there are also correct answers. The first layer first places centers and sensing ranges in the data space; the second layer then learns how to combine these local signals with weights.

90f3bc732743.zh: 監督式 · Supervised區域性基函式 · Local basis
90f3bc732743.en: SupervisedLocal basis functions

c7650aed9a55.zh: SOM：自己找同類湊一坨 Organize by similarity
c7650aed9a55.en: SOM: find your own kind and clump together

7f18a71a5286.zh: 它是無監督式學習：沒有標準答案。每次找出最像輸入的勝者，再讓鄰居一起學，逐步形成有順序的 1D 或 2D 地圖。Unsupervised learning: a winner and its neighbors learn together to form an ordered map.
7f18a71a5286.en: It is unsupervised learning: there are no correct answers. Each time, it finds the winner that is most similar to the input, then lets the neighbors learn along with it, gradually forming an ordered 1D or 2D map.

ccdbf085058b.zh: 無監督式 · Unsupervised拓撲保序 · Topology-preserving

b011fcc9adab.zh: 先記住一句話 · One-line memory

19814b94e852.zh: RBF 把「距離」變成區域性響應；SOM 把「相似性」變成格子上的鄰近關係。RBF turns distance into local response; SOM turns similarity into neighborhood.
19814b94e852.en: RBF turns “distance” into a local response; SOM turns “similarity” into proximity on the grid.

28eadad53854.zh: RBF：兩層，把區域性訊號接起來 Two layers of local response
28eadad53854.en: RBF: two layers that wire local signals together

635397e175ca.zh: RBF 先算「離哪一面旗子近」，再把區域性回應加權合成預測。 · Local responses are weighted into a prediction.
635397e175ca.en: RBF first works out “which flag it is close to,” then combines the local responses, weighted, into a prediction.

044c29f47c73.zh: 第一層：固定基函式 · Fixed basis functions

d0d7d8812335.zh: RBF 的「偷懶」之處：不要求第一層反覆學所有權重，而是在資料空間選中心 $\mu_j$，用 $\sigma_j$ 決定感應範圍。The first layer places centers and widths to detect local regions.
d0d7d8812335.en: Where RBF “slacks off”: it doesn’t make the first layer learn all of its weights over and over; instead, it picks centers $\mu_j$ in the data space and uses $\sigma_j$ to set the sensing range.

936acd05821c.zh: 第二層：可訓練權重 · Trainable weights

c16ddefd0ed1.zh: 輸入透過每個高斯旗子後，得到一組區域性回應 $\phi_j(x)$；第二層學習 $W$，把它們加權組合成輸出。The second layer combines local responses with trainable weights.
c16ddefd0ed1.en: After the input passes through each Gaussian flag, we get a set of local responses $\phi_j(x)$; the second layer learns $W$ and combines them, weighted, into the output.

42eca9aae6b6.zh: RBF 核心計算 · Core equations

bf607916f3af.zh: 距離越近，$\phi_j(x)$ 越大；距離很遠時，回應快速趨近於 0。Nearer centers respond more strongly; faraway centers fade toward zero.
bf607916f3af.en: The smaller the distance, the larger $\phi_j(x)$; when the distance is large, the response quickly approaches 0.

e5677fda7db9.zh: 數值示例：一面高斯旗子怎麼預測？ One Gaussian flag, one prediction
e5677fda7db9.en: Worked example: how does one Gaussian flag make a prediction?

41ac2a4f7932.zh: 把抽象的「區域性感應」化成三步：量距離、算回應、乘上權重。Turn locality into three moves: measure distance, compute response, apply the weight.
41ac2a4f7932.en: Turn the abstract idea of “local sensing” into three steps: measure the distance, compute the response, multiply by the weight.

aa30fc1dea60.zh: $1/(2\sigma_1^2)=1/2=0.5$，所以 $\phi_1(4)=e^{-0.5}\approx0.606$。The nearby flag responds about 0.606.

d62af4e2cbac.zh: 直覺：$x=4$ 離中心 $3$ 很近，所以旗子有感應。 ŷ = 1.212 Intuition: the input is close to the center, so the local detector is active.
d62af4e2cbac.en: Intuition: $x=4$ is very close to the center $3$, so the flag responds. ŷ = 1.212

0fe6b23cf3ab.zh: 最小二乘：數學家的「一步到位」 Closed-form least squares
0fe6b23cf3ab.en: Least squares: the mathematician’s “one step and done”

ae2cb341ec4a.zh: 把所有區域性回應堆成 Φ，再直接求出最佳 W。 · Stack local responses into Φ, then solve for W.
ae2cb341ec4a.en: Stack all the local responses into Φ, then solve directly for the best W.

a62395628ece.zh: 把全部基函式輸出寫成矩陣 $\Phi$。Collect basis responses in Φ.
a62395628ece.en: Write all the basis-function outputs as a matrix $\Phi$.

68ad0c59644f.zh: 把正確答案整理成 $Y$。Collect target outputs in Y.

512d6b59ea2d.zh: 讓 $W^\top\Phi$ 與 $Y$ 的誤差範數最小。Minimize the residual norm.
512d6b59ea2d.en: Minimize the norm of the error between $W^\top\Phi$ and $Y$.

bd90032f8231.zh: 若 $\Phi\Phi^\top$ 是奇異矩陣，不能直接取逆；改用偽逆 $\Phi^+$，仍能得到一個穩健解。If the matrix is singular, use the pseudo-inverse.
bd90032f8231.en: If $\Phi\Phi^\top$ is a singular matrix, you can’t invert it directly; use the pseudo-inverse $\Phi^+$ instead, and you still get a robust solution.

01947b2ca48c.zh: 閉式解與偽逆 · Closed form and pseudo-inverse

4f39d040fe0b.zh: 這裡的「偷懶」不是不學，而是把可用的線性代數一次算完，不必反覆梯度疊代。The shortcut is algebraic: solve the available linear problem directly instead of iterating.
4f39d040fe0b.en: The “laziness” here isn’t about not learning; it means doing all the available linear algebra in one go, with no need for repeated gradient iterations.

3b5389f22ca1.zh: SOM：沒有答案，也能長出一張地圖 A map without labels
3b5389f22ca1.en: SOM: no answers, yet a map still grows

4ee50b934c65.zh: SOM 將相似輸入安排在格子上相近的位置。 · Similar inputs activate nearby map neurons.
4ee50b934c65.en: SOM places similar inputs at nearby positions on the grid.

c188e59ee70d.zh: SOM 是單層網路，把神經元排成 1D 或 2D 格子；沒有標籤，也不預先指定簇。A single-layer 1D or 2D lattice organizes data without labels or preset clusters.
c188e59ee70d.en: SOM is a single-layer network that arranges its neurons in a 1D or 2D grid; there are no labels, and no clusters are specified in advance.

e514b81c95be.zh: 相似的輸入不只要分到相同區域，還應該落在地圖上相鄰的位置；這就是「鄰居一起學」的理由。Similar inputs should remain neighbors on the map.
e514b81c95be.en: Similar inputs should not only be assigned to the same region, they should also land at neighboring positions on the map; this is the reason that “neighbors learn together.”

4a2c9344fa99.zh: SOM 五步：神經元的選秀大賽 The five-step training loop
4a2c9344fa99.en: SOM in five steps: a talent contest for neurons

0fda4f5989c4.zh: 先看兩個核心公式 · Two core equations

bc0048961420.zh: $z$ 是最接近輸入的 BMU；$h_{zj}(t)$ 決定第 $j$ 個神經元受鄰域影響的強度。z is the best matching unit; h controls neighborhood influence.
bc0048961420.en: $z$ is the BMU (best matching unit), the unit closest to the input; $h_{zj}(t)$ determines how strongly the $j$-th neuron is influenced by the neighborhood.

4d84145db0bc.zh: 所有神經元權重先設成小隨機值。Start with small random weight vectors.
4d84145db0bc.en: First set the weights of all neurons to small random values.

7ec9d4e84e14.zh: 選一筆輸入 $x$，讓整張地圖開始比對。Present one input vector x.
7ec9d4e84e14.en: Choose one input $x$ and let the whole map start comparing.

dde3b4924076.zh: 距離最近的神經元成為勝者 $z$。The nearest neuron becomes the BMU.
dde3b4924076.en: The neuron at the smallest distance becomes the winner $z$.

d7cd52f71a32.zh: 勝者與 $N_z$ 內的鄰居一起向 $x$ 移動。The BMU and its neighbors move toward x.
d7cd52f71a32.en: The winner and its neighbors within $N_z$ move toward $x$ together.

c59cf58b63f0.zh: $\eta(t)$ 與鄰域半徑逐步縮小，直到收斂。Learning rate and radius decay toward convergence.
c59cf58b63f0.en: $\eta(t)$ and the neighborhood radius shrink step by step until convergence.

95899efafed3.zh: 相似資料會被對映到格子上的相鄰神經元；測試時只要找 BMU，就能知道它落在哪個簇。After training, nearby map units reveal clusters; testing only requires finding the BMU.
95899efafed3.en: Similar data are mapped to neighboring neurons on the grid; at test time, you only need to find the BMU to know which cluster a sample falls into.

963dbc20ef82.zh: 精準圖解：區域性性與鄰域如何同時發生？ Precision figures
963dbc20ef82.en: Precise figures: how do locality and neighborhoods happen at the same time?

dbd2eee3e39f.zh: 左圖用 $\mu=2,\sigma=1$ 的高斯 RBF 固定公式；右圖用 10×10 SOM 格子標出 BMU 與早期／晚期鄰域半徑。The left panel fixes the Gaussian parameters; the right panel shows a 10×10 SOM with early and late neighborhoods.
dbd2eee3e39f.en: The left panel uses the fixed formula of a Gaussian RBF with $\mu=2,\sigma=1$; the right panel uses a 10×10 SOM grid to mark the BMU and the early/late neighborhood radii.

47e2a59c4cb2.zh: Matplotlib 精準繪製：高斯回應、BMU 勝者與衰減中的鄰域光暈。 · Matplotlib: Gaussian response, BMU, and decaying neighborhood halos.
47e2a59c4cb2.en: Drawn precisely with Matplotlib: the Gaussian response, the winning BMU, and the shrinking neighborhood halos.

2468977e65a6.zh: 在 $x=3$ 時，$\phi(3)=e^{-1/2}\approx0.607$；再遠離中心，曲線迅速下降。At x = 3, the response is about 0.607; farther inputs fade rapidly.
2468977e65a6.en: At $x=3$, $\phi(3)=e^{-1/2}\approx0.607$; farther from the center, the curve drops quickly.

8c99fbade080.zh: 紅點是 BMU；早期半徑較大，後期半徑變小，只讓更近的鄰居跟著更新。The winner is red; the neighborhood contracts over time.
8c99fbade080.en: The red dot is the BMU; the radius is larger early on and becomes smaller later, so only closer neighbors get updated along with it.

84c3262be566.zh: RBF × SOM 速查表 Quick comparison

59f29ca7de23.zh: 中心與寬度產生區域性回應，再學 $W$
59f29ca7de23.en: Centers and widths produce local responses, then learn $W$

e585d905873b.zh: 找 BMU，讓鄰域一起更新
e585d905873b.en: Find the BMU and let its neighborhood update together

57ee4610d8fd.zh: 距離 → 高斯感應強度
57ee4610d8fd.en: Distance → strength of the Gaussian response

97d1004f6610.zh: 相似性 → 格子上的鄰近位置
97d1004f6610.en: Similarity → nearby positions on the grid

24d3f37a88e7.zh: 有答案、要預測：想起 RBF；沒答案、要看資料結構：想起 SOM。Have targets and need prediction? Think RBF. No targets and need structure? Think SOM.
24d3f37a88e7.en: Have answers and need to predict: think RBF; no answers and want to see the structure of the data: think SOM.

43dec56297f2.zh: 互動探索：移動旗子，看看回應怎麼變 Explore the local response
43dec56297f2.en: Interactive exploration: move the flag and see how the response changes

ec6bf8a06fdc.zh: 拖曳 $x,\mu,\sigma$ 與 $w$，圖表與預測會依照同一條高斯公式即時重算。Adjust x, μ, σ, and w; the chart and prediction recompute from the same Gaussian equation.
ec6bf8a06fdc.en: Drag $x,\mu,\sigma$ and $w$; the chart and the prediction are recomputed in real time from the same Gaussian formula.

9bcd5987432c.zh: RBF response explorer · 高斯區域性回應
9bcd5987432c.en: RBF response explorer: Gaussian local response

ae7a3241e1c9.zh: 當前區域性回應 $\phi(x)$：0.607 預測 $\hat y=w\phi(x)$：1.213 The response depends on distance and width; the prediction also scales with w.
ae7a3241e1c9.en: Current local response $\phi(x)$:0.607 Prediction $\hat y=w\phi(x)$:1.213 The response depends on distance and width; the prediction also scales with w.

c0aecbdfe6a5.zh: 提取練習：把兩種偷懶說回來 Retrieval practice
c0aecbdfe6a5.en: Retrieval practice: explain the two kinds of “laziness” back

dc1eab759885.zh: Q1. RBF 第一層最接近哪個描述？ What does the first RBF layer do?
dc1eab759885.en: Q1. Which description best fits the first layer of an RBF network?

b93d4f4232c9.zh: A. 反覆更新所有輸出權重 · Update every output weight
b93d4f4232c9.en: A. Repeatedly update all the output weights

5bdd583e2f0e.zh: B. 以中心與寬度建立區域性基函式 · Place local basis functions
5bdd583e2f0e.en: B. Build local basis functions from centers and widths

85ff3d87d840.zh: C. 不看輸入，直接隨機分簇 · Randomly assign clusters
85ff3d87d840.en: C. Ignore the input and assign clusters at random

0e7bba844d93.zh: D. 只做鄰域拓撲更新 · Update map neighbors only
0e7bba844d93.en: D. Only perform neighborhood topology updates

7d1af8fb4c9c.zh: Q2. SOM 為什麼更新 BMU 周圍的鄰居？ Why update the BMU’s neighbors?
7d1af8fb4c9c.en: Q2. Why does SOM update the neighbors around the BMU?

c7f70cfc0dad.zh: A. 保留相似資料的拓撲鄰近性 · Preserve topological proximity
c7f70cfc0dad.en: A. To preserve the topological proximity of similar data

4f809d945568.zh: B. 讓所有神經元立刻相同 · Make all units identical
4f809d945568.en: B. To make all neurons identical right away

fee3c4baf361.zh: C. 產生監督式標籤 · Create supervised labels

759a21ff5f76.zh: D. 取代 RBF 的最小二乘解 · Replace least squares
759a21ff5f76.en: D. To replace the RBF’s least-squares solution

527b2de4465a.zh: Q3. 若 $x=4,\mu=3,\sigma=1,w=2$，預測約為多少？ What is the approximate prediction?
527b2de4465a.en: Q3. If $x=4,\mu=3,\sigma=1,w=2$, approximately what is the prediction?

3743f0b138a0.zh: RBF 用高斯旗子感應區域性特徵，再用線性代數一次求出輸出權重；SOM 用 BMU 與鄰域更新，在沒有標籤時整理出拓撲地圖。RBF detects local features and solves output weights; SOM organizes topology through winner-and-neighbor updates.
3743f0b138a0.en: RBF senses local features with Gaussian flags, then uses linear algebra to solve for the output weights in one go; SOM uses the BMU and neighborhood updates to organize a topological map when there are no labels.

506c11c4ae5e.zh: 連續誤差與線性更新。Continuous error and linear updates.

9d251b8f57a5.zh: 多層非線性表達能力。Multilayer nonlinear representation.

29a073ba14c4.zh: 把地圖變成可解釋的資料結構。Turn maps into interpretable data structure.
29a073ba14c4.en: Turning the map into an interpretable data structure.

3fb902b99903.en: AI image generation: a prompt for redrawing this figure
